flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/TS/form/TSDetails.tsx, utils/{validation,mapping}/TS/TS.ts; ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{SuspensionProcessingController,helpers/TemporarySuspensionHelper,helpers/SuspensionBaseHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/suspendednotice/SuspendedNotice.java. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: Status Fully paid, 1 point. The TS form has an optional TextAreaInput remark (max 200 characters with a remaining-characters counter). The text is sent as suspensionRemarks and stored in ocms_suspended_notice.suspension_remarks (200-character column). The 200 limit is only checked in the UI and by the DB column; the staff-apply-suspension endpoint has no length check (unlike staff-revive-suspension which does, SuspensionProcessingController.java:640). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-087 (remark auto-populated) concerns the Unclaimed Reminder table, not this TS form, so it does not change the verdict.

steps.step: The TS form has a free-text Remark field and it is not mandatory
steps.detail: TextAreaInput with source remark, label 'Remark' (TSDetails.tsx:120-128). TSFormValidation only requires suspension_code and day_no; remark is not in the rules (TS.ts:61-70), so 'if any' is met.

steps.step: The remark is limited to 200 characters with a remaining-characters counter
steps.detail: length={200} and showCharLeft on the TextAreaInput (TSDetails.tsx:124-126); column suspension_remarks has length 200 (SuspendedNotice.java:96-97). The server does no length check on staff-apply-suspension; a direct request >200 would fail at the DB rather than be rejected with a message. The story names no limit, so this is extra.

steps.step: The remark is sent to the server and stored with the suspension
steps.detail: TSMapping sends suspensionRemarks (TS.ts:27); the controller reads payload suspensionRemarks (SuspensionProcessingController.java:224) and passes it to tsHelper.processTS (:1049); insertSuspendedNotice sets suspensionRemarks on SuspendedNotice (TemporarySuspensionHelper.java:130-133; SuspensionBaseHelper.java:459).
